name: ChosenInlineResult
description:
Represents a [result](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinequeryresult) of an inline query that was chosen by the user and sent to their chat partner.

**Note:** It is necessary to enable [inline feedback](https://core.telegram.org/bots/inline#collecting-feedback) via [@BotFather](https://t.me/botfather) in order to receive these objects in updates.

fields.name: result_id
fields.description: The unique identifier for the result that was chosen

fields.name: from
fields.description: The user that chose the result

fields.name: location
fields.description: Sender location, only for bots that require user location

fields.name: inline_message_id
fields.description: Identifier of the sent inline message. Available only if there is an [inline keyboard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinekeyboardmarkup) attached to the message. Will be also received in [callback queries](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#callbackquery) and can be used to [edit](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#updating-messages) the message.

fields.name: query
fields.description: The query that was used to obtain the result
